CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR RAI ---------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Mukesh Bihari Lal, Advocate For the State : Ms. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P.
For O.P. No.2.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Dhanbad P.S. Case No. 401 of 2023 for the offences registered under Sections 498A, 406, 323, 504, 34 of Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Dhanbad.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner is husband of informant and other in-laws have already been admitted to anticipatory bail by learned Additional Sessions Judge-X,
Dhanbad.
3. He further undertakes that petitioner shall join investigation as and when required and he shall not flee away from justice.
Upon aforesaid premise, prayer of anticipatory bail has been made.
4. Learned A.P.P. for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail application.

5. Heard the parties and perused the records.
6.
Perusal of record transpires that O.P. No. 2/ informant was validly served with notice in the present case, but till the date, no one appeared on behalf of O.P. No.2/informant.

1 7.

There is allegation against the petitioner and others regarding alleged demand of Rs.5,000,00/-
and one motorcycle and on account of non- fulfillment of above said demands, O.P. No.2/ informant was kicked out from her matrimonial home.
Nothing has been brought to notice of this Court that why custodial interrogation/trial is required in the present case.

8. Considering the totality of aforesaid facts and circumstances, this Court is inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner, accordingly, petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court below within four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender, shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Dhanbad, in connection with Dhanbad P.S. Case No. 401 of 2023,
subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Arun Kumar Rai, J.) Suman/
